messages:
emily: Quick OKR milestone sync — can folks drop a 1-line status update for their owned items below by EOD? TL;DR: streaming v2 shipped, autoscaler slipped, model selector partial. Please call out blockers, owners, and next steps.
- Streaming v2 (owner: raj) — due 3/25
- Dedicated autoscaler (owner: kevin) — due 3/28
- Model selectors + fallback (owner: sophia) — due 3/30

raj: Streaming v2 -> shipped to prod yesterday. Canary at 2% then ramped to 100%. Early metrics: p50 token latency down ~5%, cost per token up ~0.5% (expected). No customer-facing incidents. Post-deploy notes and perf dashboards: https://redwood.internal/ops/streams-v2. No blockers from my side.

kevin: Autoscaler status: slipped. During burst load tuning we saw oscillation and instance thrash. Root cause looks like threshold hysteresis too tight + some race in scale-down path. Filed ENG-INF ticket #345 and opened PR with mitigations: https://git.redwood/infra/autoscaler/pulls/89. ETA +2w for full fix. Temporary mitigation: cap concurrent bursts via circuit breaker config on dedicated pools. Need infra help to change instance lifecycle knobs.

luis: I can take the infra change. Need the load profiles/trace logs and a quick repro to validate. Can you attach the k6 profiles or a short harness? Also we should pick a maintenance window. /cc @kevin

sophia: Model selector update: A/B routing lives in staging; fallback wiring to quantized variant is failing due to a metadata schema mismatch (model_variant field vs variant_id). Error snippet:
```
ERROR: selector.lookup failed: missing field 'variant_id' on request metadata
```
Working on a small shim but need prod test vector and one extra CR approval for the routing middleware. Blocking rollout until fallback is deterministic.

nicole: From Product: autoscaler slip impacts Dedicated customer SLAs and billing predictability. Recommend we prepare a short customer-facing note and notify sales/CS. I can draft language and run it by legal. Also we should flag priority for customers on reserved capacity.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: raj deployed streaming-v2 to production at 202x-xx-xxT14:12:03Z (canary -> full). No rollback events.

raj: Quick asks: please review my CR #512 (perf harness changes) so we can merge before infra validation. Link: https://git.redwood/serving/pulls/512. Need one more approval from eng oncall.

kevin: @luis thanks — can infra slot this as next oncall item? Also I need a canary plan for the autoscaler change (how we validate, metrics to watch, rollback knobs). I can draft the canary steps by EOD.

luis: I'll slot ENG-INF #345 into Tuesday maintenance window and assign. Raj — please drop a short test harness + expected threshold numbers into the ticket so I can run an A/B. I'll also prepare a canary checklist and post it in the ticket.

emily: Thanks everyone — action items: raj update CR + attach test harness; kevin write canary plan; luis schedule infra change and run A/B; nicole draft customer note. I'll close the loop in tomorrow's sync and follow up if we need an exec escalation. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :thumbsup: from raj, :eyes: from nicole)
